result.title: Struct2Det: Grounding Category Structure in Visual Evidence for Few-Shot Object Detection
result.summary: Few-shot detectors struggle to distinguish categories that look alike but differ in local components, because a few examples rarely reveal which differences determine category identity. Category descriptions specify components and relations but do not establish their presence in an image. We propose Struct2Det, which uses category structure to guide detection and verify candidates in three stages. Relational Structure Encoding maps category graphs to component embeddings and a global condition. Component-Grounded Detection uses component queries to retrieve multi-scale image evidence that, with the global condition, modulates category text embeddings for initial detection. Verification-Guided Refinement matches candidate regions with components expected by their top-scoring categories; when class scores are close and matches are reliable, matched pairs correct region features before the shared detector predicts again. Category structure informs both classification inputs: text embeddings integrate image-wide component evidence, while region features incorporate candidate-specific matches. We also construct InduSym, with 88,912 symbol instances across 275 categories from 674 engineering drawings and a structural graph per category. Struct2Det improves few-shot-category AP over the strongest baseline by 6.02 points on InduSym and 9.68 on Digitize-PID, with the highest base-category AP on both. InduSym ablations show few-shot gains from correct category structure, image-level retrieval, and candidate verification. Further tests show gains in few-shot natural-object detection and zero-shot Chinese character recognition.

AI.brief_summary: Struct2Det 面向少样本目标检测：把类别图结构编码为部件嵌入与全局条件，用部件查询从多尺度图像中检索证据以调制类别文本嵌入，并依据候选与其高分类别部件是否匹配来校正区域特征后再检测；同时构建含结构图的工程图纸数据集 InduSym。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「部件查询检索视觉证据 + 匹配可靠性决定是否校正特征」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、候选验证与基于证据的状态更新提供借鉴线索，但机制限于检测框分类输入，需核查能否迁移到推理期 latent 状态。
